title: Enhanced photocatalytic hydrogen production efficiency using urea-derived carbon nitride in a continuous flow reactor
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01239A, Paper
Samar Batool, Malek Y. S. Ibrahim, Florian Ehrlich-Sommer, Stephen Nagaraju Myakala, Shaghayegh Naghdi, Alexey Cherevan
In this study, we conducted a comprehensive comparison of the photocatalytic properties and the reactivity towards the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) of carbon nitride (GCN) in batch and flow photo-reactors.
